reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for in-place conversation rewind within the same session, with an optional user-selected restore of workspace files changed by tracked editing tools.

summaries.zh: 用于在同一会话内将 DeepSeek Harness 对话回退到较早的用户消息，并可选恢复受支持编辑工具修改的工作区文件。
summaries.en: Rewinds a DeepSeek Harness conversation to an earlier user message in the same session and optionally restores workspace files changed by supported editing tools.

capabilities: Rewinds the model-visible conversation to an earlier user message within the same session
Stops an active model turn before rewinding
Creates and persists before-state backups for selected file-editing tool operations
Optionally restores modified files or deletes files created after the rewind target
